method.class_transport: Transport every representative projective root through each stored exact representative-to-member PGL2(Q) matrix.
method.preimage_test: For each target and class representative form the primitive projective degree-24 equation denominator(j_target)*c4(u)^3-numerator(j_target)*Delta(u)=0. A prime with no P1(F_p) root proves a QQ miss; otherwise factor exactly over QQ.
method.twist_test: Compare short models by A_target=q^2*A_fibre and B_target=q^3*B_fibre. A rational square q gives a QQ-isomorphism; a nonsquare q is a nontrivial quadratic twist. At j=0 or 1728, first test whether the sextic or quartic twist is quadratic.
